caseNameFull: Honda Motor Co., Ltd. v. Coons
judges: Appeal, Dismiss, Jurisdiction, Rehnquist, Stevens, Want

opinions.text:
Appeal from Super. Ct. N. J., App. Div. Judgment vacated and case remanded for further consideration in light of G. D. Searle & Co. v. Cohn, ante, p. 404.

Justice Rehnquist, Justice Stevens, and Justice O’Connor would dismiss the appeal for want of jurisdiction.
